An '''astromech droid''' was assigned to [[Gold Two (rebellion)|Gold Two]]'s [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] during [[Operation Handoff]] in [[2 BBY]]. When Gold Two became injured and was unable to pilot their Y-wing, the droid watched [[Commander]] [[Ezra Bridger]] of [[Phoenix Squadron]] take over for her.<ref name="SC" />
